EEL4205.title: Electric Machinery
EEL4205.prerequisites: UCF, the only carrier: EEL3004C Linear Circuits I with a minimum grade of C. UCF offers it in Fall and Spring only. It sits on the Power & Renewable Energy track as a senior elective, beside EEL4216 Fundamentals of Electric Power Systems; EEL3123C Linear Circuits II and EGN3420 Engineering Analysis are not required for it but make the AC and phasor work much easier.

offering_notes.summary: One public carrier, the University of Central Florida, at 3 credits, Fall and Spring only. UNF and FAU (EEL4220), USF (EEL4224) and Florida Poly (EEL3211) teach electric machines under other numbers.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida's convention of 15 contact hours per credit for a lecture course; UCF publishes 0 laboratory hours for EEL4205 and no contact-hour figure.

offerings.title: Electric Machinery
offerings.note: Senior elective, Power & Renewable Energy track of the B.S. in Electrical Engineering. Fall and Spring only. Prerequisite EEL3004C, minimum grade C. Catalogue: "Fundamentals of DC and AC electric machines."
